summary: Three traps added to /ui-redesign-tracker from this branch's skill capture; nothing changes how the skill decides. T21: the game blends UI in linear light, so a see-through dark plate is far thinner over a bright ground than its alpha reads and a web drawing hides it (compute the contrast over white). T22: look at a menu build in Amoebius before calling it built, and what that look does not tell you. T23: a generator's negative control names the rule that must catch it, and a token list is read from the code that fills it.
why: Garrett asked for the pilot scenes in the game; running the merged menu in Amoebius found the profile page's plates too thin over a bright scene. Docs/REFACTOR_BACKLOG.md row PP3 lists 38 other see-through dark plates in the menu generators that have never been computed over a bright ground (the replay viewer's bands are the clearest): yours to judge.
